scope: Decisions for reference-dotfiles paths that are not imported runtime source. Metadata only; private contents were not read or copied. New unclassified paths require review.

rules.detail: Use Nix modules/packages and portable Stow helpers instead of Arch installers or cached binaries.
Do not restore the old distribution branding or commands; personal screensaver art is captured separately.
Rust wallpaper grid and desktopctl own the wallpaper workflow.
Preserve through encrypted private transfer or fresh authentication, outside Git and the Nix store. Review public preferences separately from credentials and conversations.
Retain in the original project backup. This repository supplies its own instructions, ignore rules, ownership and deployment workflow.
Keep historical material in the original project backup; deploy the current captured source.
